content.en_US:
A specialized variant of standard buckshot, coated in anthrax bacteria. While the initial damage is lower than on standard buckshot, it comes with two additional effects:
* Poison II for 15 seconds
* The anthrax effect for 15 seconds, a hidden, otherwise uncurable effect that causes all damage taken to be 50% higher and prevents (or undoes) healing of any kind

The use of biological weapons is considered a war crime under the 1925 Geneva Protocol.
